news.body:
## One more printout than yesterday
- France-Visas wants its own proof of registration at the counter.
It registered your application yesterday afternoon, after yesterday's brief had gone out, and the confirmation says the receipt is asked for when you submit. It is not the Etudes en France printout, so having chased one does not cover the other. - Download it from the France-Visas application page and print it with the rest of the folder.
## Next week is fuller than it looks
- Business Foundations runs 12:30 to 19:00 your time, every day from Monday to Friday.
The welcome mail last night gave the hours for the first time: 8:00 to 14:30 CET, then group work. That is five working days inside your notice period, and the calendar only ever showed it as a banner across the week. - Tell Ravikanth now rather than the weekend before.
- Liesbeth needs your Career Anchor scores by the 23rd, not the 25th.
Her introduction mail asks for them at least 48 hours before the session, which the CareerGlobe booking never mentions. The questionnaires are already done, so this is one email. - Send it with the Personal Summary tab of the CareerPlan workbook.
## Off your desk since yesterday
- Good one on the KITAS: you put it to Ravi and Jishnu for approval and took the tax filing off InCorp's quote.
It now waits on Locus rather than on you, which is the first time that task has not been yours since September.
